body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2008 CES') -- <Visual News & Press Release> CSJ Global(www.csjglobal.com) are getting attention of visitors of CES 2008 in Las Vegas with its IP set-top box ‘Walk-TV’ supporting worldwide TV service.
The Walk-TV integrates a TV receiver and an external hard disk into an IP set-top box which includes recorder function. It enables you to watch any TV program of local region where it is installed.

Especially, it features a decoder that allows you to watch the programs on existing TV with a remote control as well as on a PC. It also supports features of a recorder such as rewind, fast forward and tracking controls and it could be utilized as a home monitoring device compatible with a camera.
Supporting camera installation, it is compatible with home monitoring system. Two-way video conference call is also available in case each one has the Walk-TV.
Other features include H.264 codec, 720x480 resolution, FM radio and webhard function.
